Fluorescence Polarization (mP)_A: Fluoresence polarization for replicate A, calculated from parallel and perpendicular intensity channels (milli-polarization units).
Fluorescence Intensity_A: Total fluorescence intensity for replicate A.
Fluorescence Polarization (mP)_B: Fluoresence polarization for replicate B, calculated from parallel and perpendicular intensity channels (milli-polarization units).
Fluorescence Intensity_B: Total fluorescence intensity for replicate B.
Normalized % Inhibition_A: Fluorescence polarization, normalized to plate average FP of positive and negative controls for replicate A.
Normalized % Inhibition_B: Fluorescence polarization, normalized to plate average FP of positive and negative controls for replicate B.
Normalized % Inhibition_Avg: Fluorescence polarization, normalized to plate average FP of positive and negative controls (average of A and B replicates)
Normalized Fluorescence Intensity_A: Fluorescence intensity normalized to average intensity of all wells on plate.
Normalized Fluorescence Intensity_B: Fluorescence intensity normalized to average intensity of all wells on plate.
